sentences.text: Lab Report: Model comparison on benchmarks
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
The dataset was split into 80 percent training data and the rest for testing.
Each experiment was repeated 5 times with different random seeds.
Figure 1 shows the f1 score of EfficientNet by dataset.
EfficientNet scores 14.6 points higher on MNIST than on SST-2.
On MNIST, EfficientNet obtains a F1 score of 77.6%.
On IMDB, EfficientNet obtains a F1 score of 84.2%.
As shown in Figure 1, EfficientNet scores 17.8 points higher on CIFAR-10 than on SST-2.
Figure 2 shows the test accuracy during training.
As shown in Figure 2, at epoch 6, ViT-S is 13 points better than VGG-16.
At epoch 3, VGG-16 achieves about 60% test accuracy.
As shown in Figure 2, Transformer attains a test accuracy of 67% at epoch 2.
On STL-10, XGBoost obtains an accuracy of 79.0%.
The differences between the models are discussed in the next section.
